name: Non-Disruptive SAB Runtime & Single-Foreground Downloads
changes: Recent successful SAB Queue/status/config traffic is strong liveness proof, reducing redundant localhost health probes while normal polling is healthy.
A single SAB localhost probe miss no longer immediately enters launch recovery or triggers a forced full SAB/provider configuration rewrite.
Recently healthy or actively transferring SAB runtimes receive a non-mutating recovery window before disruptive launch recovery is allowed.
Engine launch recovery reuses persisted configuration and no longer force-rewrites provider configuration merely because the SAB control channel was briefly unavailable.
A partial SAB configuration-sync failure no longer clears the sync signature and causes the three-second engine loop to rewrite every provider entry repeatedly.
Raw SAB Pause must persist before NewzDeck reports/reasserts recovery, suppressing short internal queue-state transitions.
One-package-at-a-time mode now guarantees at most one Active foreground package even if SAB briefly reports several slots as Downloading.
Per-package downloaded bytes remain monotonic during a live transfer so reconnect/handoff snapshots cannot reset a package back toward zero progress.
Diagnostics exposes transient control-probe misses, deferred disruptive recovery, true launch recovery, config retry-storm suppression, multi-Active corrections, and progress-regression corrections.
regression_guards: A genuine sustained SAB outage still enters launch recovery after the debounce window.
A genuinely fresh SAB admin generation still synchronizes configuration because fresh generation invalidates the prior sync signature.
Provider/settings changes still generate a new configuration signature and synchronize normally.
Sustained provider no-progress recovery retains the ability to repair missing provider configuration.
Intentional NewzDeck Pause remains immediate and authoritative.
v3.6.18 idle-aware pause handling remains preserved.
v3.6.17 canonical Downloads state, visible-live-job invariant, Remaining consistency, and Smart Import recovery remain preserved.
v3.6.16 verified Failed/Completed Remove/Cancel remains preserved.
